fact.en: Confusing the Jain Councils with Buddhist Councils (Jain: Pataliputra/Valabhi; Buddhist: Rajagriha/Vaishali/Pataliputra/Kashmir).
fact.hi: Confusing the Jain Councils with Buddhist Councils (Jain: Pataliputra/Valabhi; Buddhist: Rajagriha/Vaishali/Pataliputra/Kashmir).

fact.en: Assuming the Jain canon was fully written down during the first council; it was largely oral until the second.
fact.hi: Assuming the Jain canon was fully written down during the first council; it was largely oral until the second.

fact.en: Incorrectly linking the first council with the rise of the Digambara sect exclusively; it was a collective effort before the final split.
